answers.why: Jehu sends throughout Israel to gather all the worshippers of Baal.
Jehu removes Baal worship from the nation of Israel.
Jeroboam led Israel into sin through the golden calves.
Jehu's descendants will occupy the throne of the kingdom of Israel.
The LORD is identified as the God of the nation Israel under Jehu.
Jeroboam's sins caused the people of Israel to sin.
Hazael attacks them as the LORD begins reducing Israel's territory.
Jehu reigns over Israel from Samaria for twenty-eight years.
Jehoahaz reigns over the kingdom of Israel in Samaria.
Jeroboam caused the nation ruled by Jehoahaz to sin.
The LORD delivers Israel into Syrian hands, referring to them collectively.
The king of Syria oppresses Israel, explicitly described as them.
Israel receives a deliverer and the people escape Syrian control.
Israel continues in the sins introduced by Jeroboam's house.
Jehoash reigns over the kingdom of Israel from Samaria.
Jeroboam made the people of Israel sin through practices Jehoash continues.
Joash calls Elisha Israel's chariot and horsemen, invoking the nation's military protection.
Hazael oppresses Israel throughout Jehoahaz's reign.
